parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The return result of the request.

parameters.name: SQLId
parameters.description: The ID of the OceanBase cluster.

parameters.name: TenantId
parameters.description:
The index recommended for the SQL statement after calculation by the diagnostic system.   
- If the recommended index is the primary key, PRIMARY is returned.  
- If an index created by the user is recommended, the index name is returned.   
The system recommends only one index for an SQL statement. You can call the DescribeIndexes operation to view the indexes of a table.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oceanbasepro describe-recommend-index --tenant-id t2mr3oae00000 --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --sql-id 8D6E8400000B8FB1823D199E2CA10000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oceanbasepro DescribeRecommendIndex --region cn-hangzhou --TenantId t2mr3oae00000 --InstanceId ob317v4uif0000 --SQLId 8D6E8400000B8FB1823D199E2CA10000
